description: Freight and commodities carried by Pakistan Railways is a series of data sets listed in opendata.com.pk, an open data portal, published or maintained by Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS). Commodities Carried by Pakistan Railways 2010-2020. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS). Its tags are Pakistan, commodities, pakistan railways. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2023-04-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-pk-portal.
